summary: Frontend-only regression for the international-transfer AuthGate removal. Verified the bug fix end-to-end: on both Germany (IBAN/SWIFT) and United States (routing+account) submits, NO passcode modal and NO Face ID prompt appears, no freeze occurs, and the inline receipt (testID='intl-receipt') renders within ~2s with TRN + FPID + 'Back to Home'. Domestic transfer regression passes (Test User / 60-83-71 / 12345678 / £5.00 / ref 'Reg') — Review & Continue → Confirm & Send flows straight into a receipt with Reference='Reg', TRN + FPID, no extra auth gate. Statements screen still loads correctly (12 months listed), so removing the AuthGate hook from international-transfer.tsx did not break any shared component or hook. No console errors, no dialogs, no crashes. Deprecated packages detected: expo-notifications (listener-not-supported-on-web warning is informational only, not a deprecation).

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' warnings across screens (login, transfers, international-transfer). Non-blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow for future RN compatibility.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning emitted during submit flows. Non-blocking but should be moved into style prop.

action_items: None for the reported bug — the AuthGate removal on international-transfer.tsx is verified working for DE + US and does not affect other flows.
Optional cleanup: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and move pointerEvents into style to silence RN 0.7x deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: international-transfer.tsx is 623 lines — still under the 700 LOC threshold but approaching it; consider extracting COUNTRY_PRESETS + the two Modal pickers into separate files for maintainability.

submit() uses Alert.alert for both validation errors and API errors, which on iOS Expo Go can occasionally stack modals. Consider migrating validation errors to inline field-level messages (the receipt path is already inline, which is why the freeze went away).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login passcode selectors are [data-testid="passcode-key-{digit}"] (not passcode-{digit}). International transfer default country is DE; use [data-testid="country-picker-btn"] + [data-testid="country-{ISO2}"] to switch. Success receipt testIDs: intl-receipt, rcpt-trn, rcpt-fpid, rcpt-done. Domestic transfer flow: fill inputs -> transfer-now-button -> confirm-send-btn -> receipt-done-btn.
rca_of_issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent): international-transfer.tsx previously wrapped submit() behind authGate.confirm() which rendered a second full-screen Modal (AuthGate) on top of the transfer screen. On iOS Expo Go, dismissing that Modal and immediately opening an Alert.alert caused a modal-on-modal race that locked the JS thread and looked like a freeze. Fix: removed useAuthGate import, authGate hook call, the gate check inside submit(), and the <authGate.Render /> mount. Also, success is now rendered as an inline receipt card (setReceipt state) instead of Alert.alert, which eliminates the residual modal-on-modal risk. Verified: DE + US flows both submit → receipt with TRN + FPID directly, zero dialogs captured by Playwright, zero authgate DOM elements post-submit.
